description: Reproducible synthetic coastal test, not a measured Sydney sea state. ENU vectors point TO the flow direction.
notes: Wave amplitudes sum to 0.10 m (maximum bound H=0.20 m), not a specified significant wave height. Deep-water linear dispersion and orbital flow; stripwise quasi-hydrostatic buoyancy. Wind Cd*area, COM, inertia and hydrodynamics require real-boat calibration. No breaking/slamming/radiation/diffraction or high-sea certification.
